scope: Standing East-to-NE bridge; four new holds plus frozen endpoints, no other directions, moving actions, default or encounter acceptance
source_policy: Weapon-free base/trigger/support plates; all four new outputs retained and selected. Native palette/registration via previously authorized RasterFrameExport + uniform source registration; no anatomy painted in scripts.

jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent pixel-art Survivor standing aim authoring plate, bridge between received East and NE poses.
Input image 1 is the East identity/layer layout reference. Input image 2 is the NE endpoint identity/layer reference. Make ONE new intermediate pose at 9 degrees upwards from screen-right, actual barrel bearing 351 degrees. This is NOT a new character or another action.
Output composition: same wide three-column transparent plate as references. Left column: ONE clean whole-body base with hidden torso fully drawn and NO forearms/hands attached. Center column: ONE isolated trigger forearm and ONE trigger hand. Right column: ONE isolated support forearm and ONE support hand. Exactly three distinct pieces with ample blank gaps; no duplicated fingers, extra hands or extra arms.
Keep brown hair, orange scarf, navy jacket, brown backpack, brown cargo pants, orange boots, same silhouette/scale/standing foot placement/pixel palette and pixel size as East reference. Gradually turn upper torso from East toward NE by 9/45 of the way; head identity stays the same. The trigger arm is bent from near chest to the rear rifle grip, the support arm extends naturally to a raised fore-end 9 degrees above screen-right, more raised than East and less raised than NE. Two cuff attachment areas must join the clean jacket, wrists anatomically plausible. Trigger palm and support palm are NOT at the same height: support palm is above and ahead, consistent with a long rifle angled 9 degrees up.
The rifle is only an imagined construction constraint, NEVER paint it. NO weapon, NO gun, NO rifle, NO barrel, NO muzzle, NO magazine in ANY column. Empty hand shapes should be suitable for gripping a separately rendered rifle, not holding an invented prop. Each isolated arm is an independently editable authored piece; do not combine the two arms. Match the crisp anime pixel-art medium and exact outfit, no smooth illustration, no gradients, no text, no labels, no guides, no checkerboard, genuine transparent background.
The lower body and feet stay still; this is upper-body standing aim, not walking. Do not rotate or stretch the entire character as a substitute for authoring this intermediate hold.
jobs.status: Selected for standing bridge source/native receipt; encounter not accepted
